categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and owner identities. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
